description:
Founded in 1910, KONE is a global leader that provides elevators, escalators and automatic building doors, as well as solutions for maintenance and modernization that add value to buildings throughout their life cycle. Our mission is to improve the flow of urban life and make our world’s cities better places to live by providing innovative solutions that help make people’s journeys safe, convenient and reliable. Our operations in over 60 countries around the world has helped us achieve our position as an innovation and sustainability leader with repeated recognitions by Forbes, Corporate Knights for clean capitalism and others.  KONE’s vision is to create the Best People Flow experience by providing ease, effectiveness and experience to our customers and users. In line with our strategy, Sustainable Success with Customers, we will focus on increasing the value we create for customers with new intelligent solutions and embed sustainability even deeper across all of our operations. By closer collaboration with customers and partners, KONE will increase the speed of bringing new services and solutions to the market. KONE Technology and Innovation Unit (KTI) is where we combine the physical world – escalators and elevators – with smart and connected digital systems. We are changing and improving the way billions of people move within buildings every day. We are on a mission to expand and develop new digital solutions that are based on emerging technologies. KONE IT is a global team of expert professionals working along with business functions and area teams to develop new capabilities and enable new business opportunities. We are trusted partners of KONE business lines and functions to develop, transform, manage and run their information technology solutions. We support KONE in its digital transformation journey by introducing e.g. digital cloud-based IT services, artificial intelligence (AI) and automation to support productivity, business growth and technological disruption.Sustainability, curious mindset and innovation areat the core of everything we do, and this makes us an integral part ofKONE’s success. IT professionals - KONE Corporation Job Description We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Product Designer, Business Intelligence (BI) to join our Business Intelligence team in Chennai (preferred)/Pune .   This role focuses on designing, conceptualizing, and enhancing BI products that enable data-driven decision-making across KONE. The BI Product Designer collaborates closely with product owners, users, architects, and developers to ensure BI solutions are intuitive, scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture and governance standards. S/he actively collaborates with stakeholders inside and outside KONE IT to ensure that BI solutions deliver tangible value, meet data governance requirements, and align with KONE’s cybersecurity and architecture standards. In addition to product design responsibilities, this role may also include hands-on development tasks in Fabric & Power BI. By combining design thinking, data modelling, and iterative solution development, the BI Product Designer ensures BI products evolve according to the product vision and roadmap while enabling informed, data-driven decision-making across KONE. Main responsibilities  BI Product Design & User Collaboration   Analyze business and user needs, translating them into BI product concepts, functional specifications, and backlog items.  Work with product owners, process owners, and key users to define requirements and acceptance criteria.  Take ownership of the design and conceptualization of BI dashboards, data models, and analytical product Design fitforpurpose and fitforuse BI solutions that consider both functional (analytics, usability, accessibility) and nonfunctional (security, performance, scalability) requirements. Participate in user demos, gather feedback, and incorporate insights into design improvements.  Ensure usability, accessibility, and visual consistency of BI dashboards and models.  BI Solution Development & Optimization Design APPs, Reports & semantic models involving very large datasets, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and maintainability. Create & maintain high quality technical design documents, including data models, logic descriptions, and architectural diagrams in Confluence & Sharepoint.   Provide clarifications and support to developers, data engineers, and testers during implementation, verification, and validation Identify data-quality issues early in the pipeline and escalate appropriately. Troubleshoot issues related to BI data sources, model performance, and platform connectivity.  Monitor & Optimize BI solutions for performance, scalability, and security.  IT Product Operations Support Operations teams in managing major incidents and other critical issues related to BI product operations. Enforce governance policies , data quality practices, and architectural standards for BI solutions Collaboration & Ways of Working Actively support the Product Owner in backlog prioritization and maintaining the BI product roadmap Work directly with the BI Product Owner, Lead developer, Data engineer  and business stakeholders to clarify requirements before development begins. Actively participate in Scrum or Kanban workflows, ensuring work items are properly captured, documented, and updated in Jira. Communicate proactively—raising blockers, risks, and design concerns early. Contribute to iterative delivery, focusing on incremental value rather than large one-off deliveries. Requirements for the role Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and morden data architectural principles. Strong grasp of UX principles in BI design and delivery. Hands on experience with Microsoft Power BI, Fabric , DBT and Proficiency with version control systems (e.g., GitHub). Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Proficiency in scripting languages such as SQL, DAX, Python and Power Query. Actively exploring and applying AI-assisted capabilities to improve productivity in BI solution development and delivery. Working in virtual matrix team with outstanding emotional intelligence skills, able to motivate team, remove the impediment, build excellent collaboration and psychological safe environment, champion for teamwork  Preferred Certifications: PL-300: Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst, DP-600: Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer, DP-605: Develop Reports with Power BI At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized.
